dimension_diagnostic.rule: Keep the printed scale. Proposed east-inner trace length differs from reported8.8m; contour/elevation datum and scan distortion are not independently bounded. Do not force dimensional agreement or treat the picking envelope as total archaeological uncertainty.

axes.rule: Orthogonal foot must lie between the selected finite endpoints. Outside feet are inadmissible, not distance matches.
Minimum straight distance to the finite trace, including its endpoint; separate exploratory convention, unprescribed by entry.
Unknown: early pipe contacts the north short side, with no demonstrated connection to either retained long side. Do not prepend an invented route along the wall.
Unresolved: arbitrary wall-origin, slope and vertical models lack a specified ancient datum. No all-axis exclusion.

uncertainty_envelopes.basis: Approximate8px terminal symbol and blurred contour picks in full2x raster; scale ticks about1–2px wide. Analyst visual envelope, not field-survey accuracy.
Doubled visual-picking envelope to expose sensitivity. Does not bound scan distortion, physical face position, phase or invert uncertainty.

decision_rule: At published-plan level, a distance-envelope miss requires disjointness for the entire cubit continuum. Conservative envelope overlap is possible compatibility only, not existence of a perturbed fit. Missing archaeological gates leave the entry/feature claim not identifiable. No formal outcome-ledger increment.
